blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The ability to learn and generalize from limited experience, or sample efficiency, is a cornerstone of intelligence. How can we build language models that turn a few user interactions, a few snippets of unfamiliar code, or a handful of experimental results provided in context into knowledge that generalizes? Prior work has found that sleep, a process where the model performs $N$ recurrent forward passes to refine its representations of a chunk of context, can improve long-context reasoning (specifically, within SSM-attention hybrid models). We study whether this method also improves in-context adaptation on general, non-synthetic tasks for transformer language models. To this end, we pre-train language models up to 1.2B-parameters on up to 100B tokens with sleep mechanisms. Notably, longer sleep (i.e., using a larger number of recurrent forward passes $N$) enables the model to learn faster in-context on multiple few-shot algorithmic, question-answering tasks, while also achieving lower next-token prediction loss on out-of-distribution evaluations. On held-out code, models with $N=2$ and $N=4$ match the no-sleep baseline's loss using $2.10\times$ and $2.39\times$ fewer tokens in-context, respectively. More broadly, we view our work as a step toward building models that have better tradeoffs between in-context adaptation and decoding latency.

blocks.en: Figure 1 : During the wake phase, our model decodes tokens at a normal speed without using any depth recurrence. blocks.en:
The ability to learn and generalize from limited experience, or sample efficiency , is a cornerstone of intelligence ( Chollet, 2019 ) .
Human learning is extremely sample efficient: a generous upper estimate of linguistic exposure over ten years is only 1.4 billion tokens ( Brysbaert et al., 2016 ) .
Yet within that time, a teenager can become a professional mathematician, chess player, rocket scientist, or a programmer, among many other professions.
Can language models learn from new experience as efficiently as humans?
In contrast with pre-training, where language models are many orders of magnitude less sample-efficient than humans, language models learn with much better efficiency via in-context adaptation : at deploy-time, language models can adapt their behavior based on its preceding input (also known as “context”), such as material published after their training-data cutoff, user preferences, and environment feedback.
Yet, a substantial gap still remains between their sample efficiency and that of humans ( Liu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
从有限的经验中学习和概括的能力,或样本效率,是智能的基石(Chollet, 2019).
人类学习极为高效的样本:十年间语言接触的慷慨高估只有14亿令牌(Brysbaert等人,2016年).
然而在这段时间内,青少年可以成为职业数学家,国际象棋棋手,火箭科学家,或者程序员等许多其他职业.
语言模型能像人类那样高效地从新经验中学习吗?
与预训相比,语言模型在许多数量级上比人类的样本效率低,语言模型通过内文本的适应学习效率要高得多:在部署时,语言模型可以根据其先前的投入(也称为“内文本”)来调整其行为,例如在培训数据截断后发表的材料、用户偏好和环境反馈。
然而,在样本效率与人类效率之间仍然存在巨大差距(Liu等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Model scaling improves sample efficiency at a high cost. One way to improve the sample efficiency of in-context adaptation is to increase model size. Kaplan et al. (2020) show that per-token loss decreases following a predictable power law, and larger models achieve a faster decrease in loss as context accumulates. 1 1 1 Note that this is a separate result from more widely known scaling law results from the same paper, which describes average loss as a function of model/dataset size. This observation is later validated at scale by Brown et al. (2020) on several in-context adaptation benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 模型缩放能以高成本提高样本效率. 提高文本内适应的样本效率的一种方法是增加模型大小. Kaplan等人(2020年)表明,人均损失在可预见电力法之后会减少,随着环境的积累,较大的模型能够更快地减少损失。 页:1 1,注意这是同一份文件中较为广为人知的缩放定律结果的单独结果,该文件将平均损失描述为模型/数据集大小的一种函数. 这一观测结果后来由Brown等人(2020年)根据若干内在适应基准进行规模验证。

blocks.en:
However, larger models increase both training and inference costs.
Inference cost is particularly limiting because it recurs with every use,
whereas training cost can be amortized over the model’s deployment lifetime.
For instance, doubling the model depth doubles KV cache size and weight size, and approximately doubles per-token decoding latency.
Demand for inference is growing rapidly, with inference-time compute soon projected to dominate the compute market; for instance, OpenAI reported that they process more than 20 trillion tokens per day ( OpenAI, 2026 ) in March 2026, which is about 2.5 times its reported volume six months earlier ( OpenAI, 2025 ) . 2 2 2 OpenAI (2026) wrote “Our APIs now process more than 15 billion tokens per minute.” OpenAI (2025) wrote “6B tokens per minute on the API platform”. This cost also matters during reinforcement-learning post-training,
where rollout generation accounts for much of the computation
.
Larger models also have a larger memory footprint, limiting the hardware on which they can run.
For instance, Kimi K3 ( Kimi Team et al., 2026a ) has 2.8 trillion parameters, and its released weights do not fit in the GPU memory of a node with eight NVIDIA B200s without additional quantization.

blocks.en:
Sleep as a mechanism for in-context adaptation. We introduce a transformer-based model architecture that learns more effectively from context without increasing the model size. As shown in Figure 1 , the model periodically goes to sleep ( Lee et al., 2026 ) , using recurrent forward passes over a chunk of context to iteratively refine its key-value cache, thereby achieving better in-context adaptation.
While Lee et al. (2026) have shown that sleep improves long-range reasoning on synthetic datasets, (a) they do not evaluate in-context adaptation on general, non-synthetic datasets, focusing instead on reasoning about evicted context, and (b) their experiments are on hybrid state-space model (SSM)-attention models. Our paper adapts the sleep idea to transformer architectures and, more importantly, demonstrates its efficacy for in-context adaptation on general tasks.
blocks.zh:
睡眠作为内衬适应的一种机制. 我们引入了基于变压器的模型架构,从上下文中更有效地学习,而不增加模型的大小. 如图1所示,该模型定期进入睡眠状态(Lee等人,2026年),利用经常前传的上下文来反复细化其键值缓存,从而实现更好的内文本调整。
虽然Lee等人(2026年)已经表明睡眠改善了合成数据集的远程推理,但(a)他们并不评价一般非合成数据集的内在文本适应,而是注重关于被逐出背景的推理,(b)他们的实验是混合状态-空间模型(SSM)-注意模型. 我们的论文将睡眠思想改造为变压器架构,更重要的是,显示出它对一般任务内文适应的功效.

blocks.en:
Result: In-context sample efficiency. Figure 2 demonstrates in-context adaptation performance as a model processes more context, tested on a 1.2B parameter model trained on 32B tokens on DCLM ( Li et al., 2024 ) with different sleep durations N N . We observe that across tasks of different nature and complexity, from algorithmic in-context adaptation tasks to next-token prediction on unseen code, models that sleep exhibit markedly better in-context sample efficiency than models that do not, and this gap increases with a longer sleep duration N N . In the leftmost panel, we see that at a 16k context token cap, a model with N = 2 N=2 and N = 4 N=4 sleep duration achieves equal next-token prediction loss with 16k prefix tokens with 2.10 × 2.10\times and 2.39 × 2.39\times less context, respectively.
As shown in the middle and the rightmost panels, sleep models have higher loss/lower accuracy than the no-sleep baseline in the first window, when little context is available and predictions rely more on knowledge stored in the weights.
Their advantage grows as context accumulates over successive sleep phases, suggesting that using sleep during the training and inference yields a model that adapts better to new context and relies less on memorized knowledge.
blocks.zh:
结果:内文样本效率。 图2显示内衬适应性能,作为比较上下文的模型过程,在DCLM(Li等人,2024年)上经过32B符号培训的1.2B参数模型上测试,睡眠时间长短不一。 我们观察到,在性质和复杂性不同的任务中,从算法内文本适应任务到对隐形代码的下层预测,睡眠的模型显示的内文本样本效率明显优于没有的模型,而这一差距随着睡眠时间更长的N N 增加。 在最左边的面板上,我们看到在16k上下文符号盖上,一个具有N = 2 N = 2和N = 4 N = 4 睡眠持续时间的模型,在16k前缀符号上,分别有2.10×2.10\时和2.39×2.39\时,实现了相等的下下文预测损失.
如中层和最右面板所示,睡眠模型的失眠/低精度高于第一个窗口的无睡眠基线,当时没有多少上下文,预测更多地依赖于存储在权重中的知识.
随着环境在连续睡眠阶段的积累,他们的优势不断增长,这表明在培训和推论期间使用睡眠可以产生一种模型,更好地适应新的环境,较少依赖记忆中的知识.

blocks.en:
Result: Performance-efficiency Pareto frontier. Compared to a no-sleep variant, the model adds less than 2 % 2\% to the parameter count, with no increase in KV-cache size. Additionally,
since the recurrent passes are performed offline during sleep, it incurs no additional wake-time latency overhead.
Overall, including sleep-time overhead, end-to-end decoding latency increases by less than 3 % 3\% with one sleep iteration and 8 % 8\% for three sleep iteration with 128k prefix for 1.2B models, allowing us to achieve Pareto-frontier compared to other looped transformer baselines ( Section 5.3 ). In aggregate, our results suggest that sleep may be a promising direction for improving in-context adaptation abilities of transformers, while incurring limited additional overhead in terms of inference latency.

blocks.en: 2.2 Sample efficiency
blocks.zh: 2.2 抽样效率

blocks.en:
Prior work attempts to improve the data efficiency of language-model pre-training by increasing training epochs, model scaling, and ensembles of independently trained models ( Lovelace et al., 2026 ; Mandal et al., 2026 ; Muennighoff et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2026 ) .
We instead study sample efficiency during in-context adaptation by scaling computational depth.
blocks.zh:
先前的工作试图提高语言模型预培训的数据效率,办法是增加培训的时代、模型规模和经过独立培训的模型的组合(Lovelace等人,2026年;Mandal等人,2026年;Muennighoff等人,2023年;Kim等人,2026年)。
相反,我们通过缩小计算深度来研究文本内调整过程中的样本效率。

blocks.en: 2.3 In-context adaptation and computational depth
blocks.zh: 2.3 内容内调整和计算深度

blocks.en:
Kaplan et al. (2020) analyze the next-token prediction loss at each token position and show that bigger models have steeper in-context adaptation curves.
Although we have yet to fully understand why this happens (rather than, for instance, having a curve with the same slope but only a different offset), existing evidence suggests that some in-context adaptation algorithms benefit from sufficient computational depth.
For example, the standard induction head circuit ( Olsson et al., 2022 ) , which performs associative in-context recall, can emerge only when two or more attention operations are composed. k k -hop induction appears to require at least log ⁡ k \log k compositions of attention ( Sanford et al., 2024 ) .
Function vectors ( Hendel et al., 2023 ; Todd et al., 2024 ) , a more complex form of in-context adaptation, can emerge when the model has enough depth to extract and apply the task vector. Von Oswald et al. (2023) show that transformers with multiple layers can emulate multi-step gradient descent in linear regression tasks.
These observations motivate the hypothesis that increasing computational depth is key for sophisticated in-context adaptation algorithms to emerge.
However, token generation latency grows linearly with the number of layers, limiting how far the model depth can be increased.
blocks.zh:
Kaplan等人(2020年)分析了每个信物位置的下位预测损失,并显示更大的模型具有更陡峭的内衬适应曲线.
虽然我们尚未完全理解为什么会发生这种情况(而不是,例如,有一个具有相同坡度的曲线,但只有不同的抵消),但现有的证据表明,一些内在适应算法得益于足够的计算深度。
例如,标准诱导头电路(Olsson et al., 2022年),它进行关联的编解,只有在两个或多个关注操作组成后才能出现. kk-hop诱导似乎至少需要log {}k\log k的注意成分(Sanford等人,2024年)。
函数向量 (Hendel等人,2023年;Todd等人,2024年),是一种比较复杂的内文适应形式,当模型有足够的深度来提取和应用任务矢量时,可以出现. Von Oswald等人(2023年)显示,多层变压器可以在线性回归任务中模仿多步梯度下降.
这些观测激发了一种假设,即提高计算深度是尖端的内文字适应算法出现的关键.
然而,代号生成延迟随着层数的线性增长,限制了模型深度的提升程度.

blocks.en: 2.4 Depth-recurrent models
blocks.zh: 2.4 深度经常模型

blocks.en:
Depth-recurrence (or “looping”) is one major pathway to increasing depth without increasing the number of parameters ( Dehghani et al., 2018 ; Graves, 2016 ; Elbayad et al., 2019 ; Schwarzschild et al., 2021 ; Bansal et al., 2022 ) .
Recent work applies depth recurrence to language models through
pretraining ( Geiping et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) or
retrofitting pretrained models ( McLeish et al., 2025 ) .
Other studies examine design choices that improve optimization
and performance ( Prairie et al., 2026 ; Schwethelm et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026a ; Saunshi et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) .
Although depth recurrence reduces parameter memory, its decoding latency and KV cache memory grow linearly with the number of loops.
Inspired by methods that share KV cache across layers in non-recurrent transformers ( Brandon et al., 2024 ; Sun et al., 2024 ; Wu and Tu, 2024 ) , prior work has proposed sharing the KV cache across loops either in a training-free manner ( Zhu et al., 2025 ; Geiping et al., 2026 ) or with training ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Vendrell et al., 2026 ; Bae et al., 2026 ) .
Among these approaches, Vendrell et al. (2026) is closest to ours. We discuss their approach in Section 3 and compare it with ours in Section 5.3 .

blocks.en: 2.5 Sleep
blocks.zh: 2.5 睡觉

blocks.en:
Several machine learning methods ( Hafner et al., 2019 ; Sutton, 1991 ; Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 ; Mnih et al., 2015 ; Hinton et al., 1995 ; Carreira-Perpinan and Hinton, 2005 ; Lin et al., 2025 ; Behrouz et al., ) use offline processing phases inspired by the role of biological sleep in animal learning ( Rasch and Born, 2013 ; McClelland et al., 1995 ) .
Recently, Lee et al. (2026) proposed a sleep-like depth-recurrence mechanism where the model converts recent context into fast weights before clearing its key-value cache.
Once the context size reaches the sleep window size W W , the model goes to sleep, during which it performs N − 1 N-1 additional depth-recurrent steps to iteratively refine fast weights, providing enough computational depth for learning.
After sleep, the model evicts context tokens and resumes decoding at normal latency, incurring no additional cost between sleeps.
On synthetic tasks, they show that increasing sleep duration N N improves the model’s ability to retrieve and reason about evicted context.
However, Lee et al. (2026) conducted experiments on synthetic datasets explicitly designed to evaluate reasoning over evicted context, and it is unclear whether this same mechanism can (a) improve in-context adaptation (rather than just reasoning) of language models trained on web text, and (b) do so even without context eviction.
In this paper, we study whether this mechanism can be scaled to transformer pre-training to improve general in-context sample-efficiency.
blocks.zh:
几种机器学习方法(Hafner等人,2019年;Sutton,1991年;Ha和Schmidhuber,2018年;Mnih等人,2015年;Hinton等人,1995年;Carreira-Perpinan和Hinton,2005年;Lin等人,2025年;Behrouz等人,)利用生物睡眠在动物学习中的作用所激发的离线处理阶段(Rasch and Born,2013年;McClelland等人,1995年)。
最近,李等编著. (2026)提出了一种类似睡眠的深度重复机制,即模型在清理其键值缓存之前,将最近的上下文转换为快速加权.
一旦上下文大小达到睡眠窗口大小WW,模型便会进入睡眠,在此期间它会执行N−1N-1附加的深度常态步骤来迭代精炼快重,为学习提供足够的计算深度.
睡完后,模型会驱逐上下文符号,在正常的空闲时间恢复解码,在睡眠之间不产生额外费用.
在合成任务方面,它们表明,增加睡眠时间N N会提高模型检索和解释被逐出环境的能力。
然而,Lee et al. (2026年)对合成数据集进行了明确设计的实验,以评估对被逐出背景的推理,目前还不清楚这种机制是否能够(a) 改进网络文本所培训的语言模型的内在适应(而不是单纯的推理),以及(b) 即使没有上下文的驱逐也能做到这一点。
在本文中,我们研究这种机制是否可以被放大到变压器预培训中,以提高一般的文本样本效率.

blocks.en:
Motivated by the memory consolidation process in the brain, Oomerjee et al. (2026) add a lightweight adapter network to a frozen language model to refine its KV cache after the frozen model predicts each chunk of tokens.
The adapter is trained to minimize the next-token prediction loss on the following chunk, without backpropagating losses from later chunks through the current refinement, as they use truncated backpropagation through time.
They train the adapter on supervised reasoning traces and observe that it improves performance on downstream reasoning tasks.
Sleep also refines the KV cache, but instead of introducing a lightweight adapter, we use the main network itself to iteratively refine the cache through depth recurrence, increasing computational depth and the expressivity of the update.
We also do not truncate gradients across windows.
Our focus is the sample efficiency of in-context adaptation, and whether increasing N N can yield further sample efficiency gains while accounting for inference cost.
blocks.zh:
受大脑内存整合过程的驱动,Oomere等人(2026年)在冷冻模型预测每块令牌后,在冷冻语言模型中添加一个轻量级适配器网络来完善其KV缓存.
适配器经过培训后,可以将以下块的下接式预测损失降到最低程度,不会通过当前修饰来背传后接式的预测损失,因为它们通过时间使用截断式反向传播.
他们对适配器进行有监督的推理痕迹的培训,并观察到它提高了下游推理任务的性能.
睡眠还精炼了KV缓存,但是我们没有引入轻量级适配器,而是利用主网络本身通过深度重现,增加计算深度和更新的表达性来迭代精炼缓存.
我们也不截断跨窗口的梯度。
我们的重点是内衬适应的样本效率,以及增加NN是否能在计算推断成本的同时产生更多的样本效率收益.

blocks.en: 2.6 Amortizing training compute during inference
blocks.zh: 2.6 在推论中计算培训费用

blocks.en:
When inference demand is large, spending more compute during training
can be worthwhile because that cost is amortized over the model’s
deployment lifetime.
One approach is to train smaller models well beyond the
Chinchilla-optimal token budget ( Sardana et al., 2023 ) .
For example, Qwen2-0.5B is pretrained on 12T
tokens ( Yang et al., 2024 ) , approximately 1,200 times the Chinchilla-optimal token budget.
However, the supply of useful training data limits how far
overtraining can extend ( Villalobos et al., 2022 ; Kim et al., 2026 ; Sutskever, 2024 ) .
This motivates methods that spend more computation per training
example while preserving inference cost.

Recent temporal-recurrence architectures illustrate this
approach ( Cai et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Huang et al., 2026b ) .
They use additional parallel refinement steps during training
to approximate recurrent computations across token positions.
During autoregressive decoding, the preceding token’s recurrent
state is already available, so each new token requires only one
forward pass.
These methods therefore spend additional training compute while
retaining approximately the decoding cost of a standard Transformer.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
We adapt sleep ( Lee et al., 2026 ) to attention-only Transformer models trained on natural language, with the aim of improving in-context sample efficiency. Lee et al. (2026) let the model periodically revisits a window of context to refine its fast weight.
Since we use attention-only transformers, we instead refine their KV cache during sleep.
Unlike Lee et al. (2026) , we retain the full context without evicting tokens.
We provide pseudocode for a toy example in Figure 4 .
blocks.zh:
我们将睡眠(Lee et al., 2026)适应只关注的变形器模型,接受自然语言的训练,目的是提高内衬样本效率. Lee et al. (2026) 让模型定期重温一个上下文窗口来完善其快速重量.
由于我们使用只注意的变压器,而是在睡眠时改进他们的KV缓存.
与Lee et al. (2026)不同,我们保留了完整的语境而不驱逐信物.
我们为图4中的玩具实例提供伪代码。

blocks.en:
During the wake phase, the model autoregressively decodes tokens with a single forward pass per token ( Figure 1 ).
After every W W tokens, it sleeps: it performs N − 1 N-1 additional depth-recurrent forward passes over the completed window to refine its KV cache.
Each token therefore receives N N forward passes in total, including the initial wake pass.
After sleep, decoding resumes at its normal speed until the next window is complete.
blocks.zh:
在醒悟阶段,模型自动解码符符,每个符符有一个单向前传(图1).
在每枚W W 令牌之后,它就会沉睡:它执行N− 1 N-1附加的深度-经常性前传通过完成的窗口来完善其KV缓存.
因此,每个符号都收到 N前方通行证共计,包括最初的醒目通行证。
睡眠后,解码恢复正常速度,直到下一个窗口完成.

blocks.en:
Figure 3 shows how this computation is organized for parallel training within each window.
The model is recurrent in depth and block-recurrent in time.
For each window of W W tokens, we apply the standard language modeling loss only to the first-loop output.
The remaining N − 1 N-1 steps refine the cache without changing the current window’s predictions.
Their effect on the loss comes from subsequent windows, whose predictions attend to the refined cache. Figure 4 shows how the forward pass works during training for a 1-layer transformer model.
After forward pass, we backpropagate through the entire computation (including N N recursions) and update the model parameters.
Since refinement steps at l ≥ 2 l\geq 2 do not need to obey causality within the current window, we use bidirectional attention during sleep.
In Figure 4 , we see that during sleep, the mask 𝐌 \mathbf{M} is not applied to the attention.
During training, after the forward pass finishes, we backpropagate through the entire computation (including recursions) and update the model parameters.

To support signal propagation through depth recurrence, we use Attention Residuals (AttnRes) ( Kimi Team et al., 2026b ) with block size four.
Following Su (2026) , we compute depth-wise attention weights using a subset of the hidden coordinates.
Rather than keeping the routing dimension constant across model sizes, we allocate 1 / 16 1/16 of the hidden dimension to routing.
We select these architectural choices using the N = 1 N=1 baseline, where they improve validation loss, and transfer them to the sleep models.

blocks.en:
We pretrain on DCLM ( Li et al., 2024 ) with a context length of 4,096 tokens.
We build upon the SmolLM-2 ( Allal et al., 2025 ) architecture and tokenizer, varying width and depth following the Marin ( Marin Community, ) scaling ladder ( Table 1 ).
We use Kimi-style Muon ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , which ties the learning rates of the Muon and AdamW parameter groups.
Following Marin, we linearly warm up the learning rate over the first 1% of optimizer updates, then linearly decay it to 5% of its peak value over the remaining updates.
Learning rates are tuned for the N = 1 N=1 baseline and reused for models with sleep.
In some of our sweeps, the best-performing learning rate
differs across loop counts, so this transfer may leave our sleep models undertuned.

blocks.en: 5 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5. 评价

blocks.en:
We start by presenting our main results on negative log-likelihood evaluations ( Section 5.1 ).
We then proceed to few-shot learning tasks, where the model should infer hidden rules from in-context demonstrations ( Section 5.2 ).
In Section 5.3 , we discuss additional experimental results including inference cost profile, ablation studies, and comparison with other looped baselines.
blocks.zh:

然后,我们着手完成一些短短的学习任务,模型应推断出从内容内演示中隐藏的规则(第5.2节)。
在第5.3节中,我们讨论了更多的实验结果,包括推论成本概况、减缩研究和与其他循环基线的比较。

blocks.en: 5.1 Negative log-likelihood evaluation
blocks.zh: 5.1 负对数相似评价

blocks.en:
Our development was largely guided by next-token negative log-likelihood (NLL) evaluation.
Although multiple choices or generative evaluations such as MMLU or MATH are common, they can be highly sensitive to minor details such as formatting and scoring rules ( Sclar et al., 2024 ) , and widely used ones are prone to contamination.
Moreover, benchmarks can be too hard for small models and thus fail to provide informative guidance at those scales ( Heineman et al., 2026 ) .
On the other hand, NLL evaluation provides a smooth signal, is less prone to minor variations such as formatting, and aligns well with downstream capabilities ( Du et al., 2024 ; Gadre et al., 2025 ) , especially when the evaluation corpus is carefully decontaminated and selected for quality.
In our setting, we leverage the fact that our training datasets, DCLM and ProLong, were released before 2025, to collect long-context data released in 2025 or later for testing purposes. arXiv2025 contains arXiv papers released in 2025 and extracted into Markdown. 3 3 3 https://huggingface.co/datasets/SlowGuess/Arxiv_2025_OCR Additionally, we created Repo2025 , which contains 13 popular GitHub repositories whose earliest commits date to 2025.
These datasets let us test how well the model can adapt to scientific text and unfamiliar codebases; it is of course likely that both arXiv2025 and Repo2025 include AI-generated text, so our evaluation may not be fully uncontaminated.
Dataset construction is described in Appendix B .

此外,对小型模型而言,基准可能太难,因此无法在这些尺度上提供翔实的指导(Heineman等人,2026年)。
另一方面,NLL评价提供顺畅的信号,不太容易发生格式化等小的变异,并与下游能力很吻合(Du等人,2024年;Gadre等人,2025年),特别是当评价委托书被精心消毒并选取质量.
在我们的环境下,我们利用我们的培训数据集DCLM和ProLong于2025年之前发布这一事实,收集2025年或以后发布的长文本数据,以供测试。 arXiv2025 包含 arXiv 论文于 2025 年发布并摘录到 Markdown. 3 3 https://huggingface.co/datasets/SlowGuess/Arxiv_2025_OCR 此外,我们创建了Repo2025,其中包含13个流行的GitHub寄存器,它们的最早承诺日期是2025年。

The middle panel of Figure 2 shows this behavior at finer resolution, using a 10-token running mean.
The loss difference becomes more negative immediately after sleep boundaries, showing that sleep is the driving factor of the loss gap. The loss difference typically drops sharply at sleep boundaries and then rises within each window. We also sometimes observe similar trends in few-shot learning tasks ( Figure 15 ). We speculate that sleep pre-computes useful representations for upcoming tokens. Since near-future tokens are easier to anticipate, the model may learn to devote more computation to preparing for them, making the benefit largest immediately after sleep and smaller farther into the window.

blocks.en: 5.2 Few-shot learning tasks
blocks.zh: 5.2 少时学习任务

blocks.en:
Although the NLL evaluation provides a robust predictor of in-context adaptation ability, we additionally evaluate on several few-shot learning tasks to complement our NLL results. CoQA ( Reddy et al., 2019 ) is a standard benchmark ( Radford et al., 2019 ; Brown et al., 2020 ; Chowdhery et al., 2023 ) where the model answers questions about a passage through a conversation.
Unlike other evaluations, this is a generative evaluation.
Here, we use greedy decoding and report F1.
For 1-, 2-, and 4-shot results, we average the scores over two fixed demonstration sets shared across models. Algorithmic word tasks test whether sleep improves models’ ability to infer the correct algorithmic rule from in-context demonstrations and apply it correctly.
We consider five tasks: word reversal, cyclic rotation, selective recall, symbol removal, and latest assignment.
For character manipulation tasks, we separate characters with spaces to reduce dependence on word tokenization.
We report the probability of the correct answer, computed from teacher-forced token probabilities, averaged over all subtasks.
We also evaluate on three tasks from the widely used ( Abdin et al., 2024 ; Kimi Team et al., 2025 ; Zeng et al., 2026 ) ICL subset of HELMET dataset ( Yen et al., 2025 ) : TREC-coarse, TREC-fine ( Li and Roth, 2002 ) , and NLU ( Liu et al., 2021 ) .
These are text classification tasks with 6, 50, and 68 labels, respectively, for TREC-coarse, TREC-fine, and NLU.
For each sequence, we randomly assign numeric labels to classes and keep the mapping fixed throughout, so the model can infer the label meanings from in-context demonstrations.
As in the algorithmic tasks, we report the probability of the correct answer averaged over all subtasks.
Finally, we evaluate in-context sentiment classification on SST-2 , replacing negative and positive with foo and bar , respectively, following Wei et al. (2023) .
These labels do not reveal their sentiment meanings, so the model must
learn the mapping from demonstrations.
Learning new association solely from context can be surprisingly hard: Wei et al. (2023) shows that even GPT-3 achieves around 60% accuracy with 32 demonstrations.
For a detailed explanation of the tasks used, see Appendix B .

Figure 6 presents the results for d2048/TP30 (or 1.2B/32B). These results show that models with sleep outperform the N = 1 N=1 baseline on few-shot learning across all four datasets. In Section A.6 , we find that the similar trend holds for d1536/TP30 (or 600M/16B) and d2048/TP90 (or 1.2B/98B) configurations.
For CoQA, the advantage is also present without prepended demonstrations because even zero-shot CoQA prompts can exceed the first sleep boundary at 256 tokens.
In algorithmic tasks, the N = 1 N=1 baseline often plateaus, while models with sleep continue to improve as demonstrations accumulate.
In SST-2, the N = 1 N=1 baseline’s gains diminish as context
accumulates, while models with sleep continue to benefit from
additional examples.
All models struggle to even achieve 50% accuracy initially, showing that even identifying a valid answer set in-context can be challenging for small models on this task.
We sometimes see that N = 2 N=2 is tied with N = 4 N=4 or even outperforms it, e.g., in CoQA and SST-2, at certain demonstration counts.
This is consistent with the fact that for d2048/TP30, the gap between N = 2 N=2 and N = 4 N=4 is smaller than that between N = 1 N=1 and N = 2 N=2 on the NLL evaluation, and that an individual few-shot learning task does not necessarily reflect a model’s general ability to adapt in context.

Figure 7 (a) shows that sleep adds no decoding
latency between sleep boundaries.
The additional latency is concentrated in periodic spikes,
when the model refines the completed window’s KV cache.
Sleep processes the window’s tokens in parallel, and its cost
is amortized over subsequent decoding steps.
As a result, with a 128k token prefix,
end-to-end cumulative decoding time (excluding time to first token) increases by only 2.6% for N = 2 N=2 and 7.6% for N = 4 N=4 . Figure 7 (b) shows that memory overhead is also small: at the longest prompt length, peak memory increases by about 1% for N = 4 N=4 (mainly due to AttnRes cache and KV gating).
The main latency trade-off is prefilling: time to first token scales approximately with N N ,
as shown in Figure 7 (c).
This additional computation lets the model process its
context more deeply before generating a response, improving
the sample efficiency of in-context adaptation.

blocks.en:
Figure 8 shows the final 256-token losses as a function of the cumulative decoding time relative to N = 1 N=1 on ProLong and Repo2025.
Unlike both looped baselines, which require N N steps to generate each token, our models do not incur wake time latency overhead and instead hide that additional FLOPs to sleep phases. Since sleep is FLOPs intensive, it achieves superior cumulative decoding latency compared to these looped baselines which incur N N times longer latency. Moreover, sleep could be flexibly scheduled during otherwise idle periods, such as while awaiting tool results or user input, without harming interactivity.

blocks.en:
Figure 10 compare the in-context adaptation curves of these methods.
We can see that full-context loops start from a lower position than our method, but eventually fall behind it, despite having N × N\times larger KV cache and being much slower in decoding.
We believe this is because full-context loops do not use block-recurrence and thus their computational depth do not grow in temporal dimension.
Block-recurrent loops show steeper learning curves than full-context loops and outperform sleep at most token positions at the cost of increased decoding latency, but sleep eventually outperforms it at later positions.
We hypothesize that this is because sleep allows recurrent computation to focus on preparing the KV cache for predicting distant future tokens, whereas block-recurrent loops must use recurrence for immediate next-token prediction as well as cache preparation, potentially creating competition between these two roles ( Monea et al., 2026 ) . This result is surprising because these baselines incur approximately 3.7 × 3.7\times more decoding latency, and full-context loops costs 4 × 4\times more KV cache memory on top of that (see Figure 8 ); nevertheless, when there is enough context for the model to adapt, sleep appears to outperform them eventually.
blocks.zh:

我们可以看到,完全的文本循环是从我们的方法的较低位置开始的,但最终落在后面,尽管有N×N\times更大的KV缓存,并且解码速度要慢得多.
我们认为,这是因为全文循环不使用区块重复,因此其计算深度在时间维度上没有增加。
块-经常环路显示比全康文字环路更陡峭的学习曲线,并且最多在象征性位置上超额睡眠,代价是解码时空增加,但睡眠最终在后期位置上超过了它.

Although AttnRes could limit cache changes by letting the query vector

Gating suppresses these spikes and improves loss at later positions. A useful analogy is the observation that people often cannot recall REM sleep ( Crick and Mitchison, 1983 ) , implying that it is useful to have the separation of generating neural activities from what is retained in memory.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We study periodic context refinement via depth recurrence, or sleep, as a way to improve
in-context sample efficiency of transformer language models without increasing model size.
Across NLL and few-shot evaluations, we show that models with sleep make more effective use of their context
and that longer sleep duration N N improves results further.
blocks.zh:
我们研究通过深度复发或睡眠来定期改进环境,作为改进的方法
变压器语言模型的内文本样本效率,而不增加模型大小。
通过NLL和几率评价,我们显示有睡眠的模型能更有效地利用它们的背景
并且睡眠时间更长 N N 进一步提高了效果.

blocks.en:
Our experiments are not iso-FLOPs.
We instead match training tokens, and sleep requires approximately N N times the training computation of the no-sleep baseline per training token.
This trade-off is attractive when inference demand is large enough to amortize the additional training cost.
Also, our method makes prefill approximately N N times slower.
Therefore, we expect the benefit to be the greatest in a decoding-heavy scenario.
blocks.zh:
我们的实验不是Iso -FLOPs。
相反,我们匹配训练标志,睡眠需要大约N倍于训练计算每个训练标志的无睡眠基线。
当推断需求大到足以摊还额外培训费用时,这种权衡是有吸引力的。
而且,我们的方法 使预填大约N倍慢。
因此,我们期望在破解重码的情况下,好处最大。

blocks.en: When a model has enough context and time to adapt, the slope of its learning curve may matter more than what it already knows. Our results strongly suggest that the performance gap between models with and without sleep will continue to widen as the context accumulates. Future work should scale this work to larger, more capable models to investigate if this trend persists at longer context and after post-training, and by investigating other opportunities for language models to improve on in-context adaptation.
blocks.zh: 当一个模型有足够的上下文和时间适应时,其学习曲线的坡度可能比它已经知道的更重要. 我们的结果表明,随着环境的累积,有睡眠和无睡眠模式之间的性能差距将继续扩大。 今后的工作应该将这项工作扩大到更大的、更有能力的模式,以调查这一趋势是否在较长的背景和经过培训后继续存在,并调查其他机会,使语言模式能够改进文字适应。

blocks.en:
We build upon the SmolLM-2 ( Allal et al., 2025 ) architecture and tokenizer, varying width and depth following the Marin ( Marin Community, ) scaling ladder.
The models are dense, global-attention only Transformers with grouped-query attention ( Ainslie et al., 2023 ) and SwiGLU activations ( Shazeer, 2020 ) .
We tie the embedding and unembedding weights, use NoPE ( Kazemnejad et al., 2023 ) in every fourth layer, and include Inkling-style residual short convolutions ( Thinking Machines Lab, 2026 ) .

这些模型是密集的,全球注意的只有具有组群-query关注的变形器(Ainslie等人,2023年)和SwiGLU激活(Shazeer,2020年).
我们将嵌入式和未嵌入式的重量捆绑起来,每第四层使用NoPE(Kazemnejad等人,2023年),并包括Inkling式的残余短演(思维机器实验室,2026年).

Following Su (2026) , we compute depth-wise attention weights using a subset of the hidden coordinates.
Rather than keeping the routing dimension constant across model sizes, we allocate 1 / 16 1/16 of the hidden dimension to routing.
We select these architectural choices using the N = 1 N=1 baseline, where they improve validation loss, and transfer them to the sleep models. Table 2 shows that these combined result in improved performance on the standard lm-eval-harness tasks compared to an external Transformer++ baseline.

Transformer stack except for embedding and unembedding layers every W = 256 W=256 tokens.

blocks.en: A.7 Discussion on test-time training
blocks.zh: A.7 关于试验时间培训的讨论

blocks.en:
Tandon et al. (2025) propose a test-time training method called TTT-E2E where the model performs gradient descent on next-token loss within context.
TTT-E2E originally aims to preserve the model’s long-context ability after sliding-window token eviction, but since its sliding window size is 8k and test-time update happens every 1k tokens, we can also examine its loss improvement over the Transformer baseline before eviction to see if it can improve in-context adaptation.
In Figure 12 , we show the plot digitized from Figure 6 (left) of Tandon et al. (2025) , where we display loss curves of their Transformer baseline and TTT-E2E.
We restrict the x-axis to positions up to 8K, before token eviction.
TTT-E2E improves loss over the baseline, but the gap remains approximately constant over this range, unlike our Figures 2 and 5 , where the gap grows as context accumulates.
We also see that the advantage is already present before the first test-time update.
Why does this happen?
This comparison between transformer and TTT-E2E in Figure 12 is not matched in terms of the size of per-sequence inference state, because unlike sleep, which updates the same KV cache that is used by a vanilla transformer, TTT-E2E introduces additional context-specific fast-weight states that are learned from context tokens in a sequence and thus cannot be shared across other independent sequences in a batch.
Having larger per-sequence inference state increases decoding latency through additional memory traffic because decoding is already memory-bound, while also improving in-context adaptation ability as noted by the authors.
For example, in their 3B parameter model, we estimate their in-context memory overhead (size of KV cache and fast weights combined) to be more than 1.5 × 1.5\times that of the Transformer baseline, which has only the KV cache.
We obtain this estimate as follows.
Their 3B model has 32 layers, and they update the final 8 layers’ SwiGLU parameters in-context. Their SwiGLU hidden and intermediate widths are 2,560 and 5,632, respectively, and the updated state is stored in 32-bit precision.
So in total, their SwiGLU state occupy 8 ⋅ 5632 ⋅ 2560 ⋅ 3 ⋅ 4 8\cdot 5632\cdot 2560\cdot 3\cdot 4 bytes, or approximately 1.29GB.
On the other hand, their KV cache is stored in 16-bit precision, and since they do not use GQA, the size is 32 ⋅ 2560 ⋅ 2 ⋅ 2 ⋅ 8192 = 32\cdot 2560\cdot 2\cdot 2\cdot 8192= 2.5GB for 8k context.
So TTT-E2E incurs roughly 51.6% larger per-sequence inference state size at 8k.
Moreover, TTT-E2E only performs a single in-context gradient step, whereas we show that increasing sleep duration leads to better performance.
blocks.zh:
Tandon等人(2025年)提出一种试验时间训练方法,称为TTT-E2E,模型在上下文中对下位子损失进行梯度下降.
TTT-E2E最初的目的是在滑窗令牌拆迁后保持模型的长文本能力,但由于其滑窗尺寸为8k,且每1k令牌都会发生测试时间更新,因此我们也可以在拆迁前检查其与变形器基线相比的损失改善情况,看看是否能够改进折纸内适应.
在图12中,我们显示了从图6(左) Tandon 等人(2025年)中数字化的图案,在那里我们显示了其变形器基线和TTT-E2E的损失曲线。
我们把X轴限制在8K以下的位置 在象征性驱逐之前
TTT-E2E使损失超过基线,但这一范围的差距大致保持不变,与我们图2和图5不同,后者随着上下文的累积而扩大。
我们还看到,在第一次测试时间更新之前已经具备了这一优势。
为什么会这样?
在图12中变压器和TTT-E2E的这种比较在每序列推论状态的大小上并不匹配,因为与更新香草变压器使用的相同KV缓存的睡眠不同,TTT-E2E引入了额外的上下文特异性快重状态,这些状态在一个序列中从上下文指示器中学习,因此无法在批次中在其他独立序列中共享.
拥有更大的每序推论状态,通过额外的内存流量来增加解码延迟,因为解码已经是内存绑定的,同时也提高了编著者指出的内文本适应能力.
例如,在他们的3B参数模型中,我们估计他们的内存内存超高(大小为KV缓存和快速权重加起来),比起只有KV缓存的变形器基线,超过1.5×1.5\时.
我们得到的估计数如下。
他们的3B模型有32层, 他们更新了最后的8层 SwiGLU 参数在文本中. 他们的SwiGLU隐藏和中间宽度分别为2,560和5,632,更新后的状态以32位精度存储.
因此,他们的SwiGLU州总共占据了8 ⋅ 5632 ⋅ 2560 ⋅ 3 ⋅ 4 8\cdot 5632\cdot 2560\cdot 3\cdot 4字节,或约1.29GB.
另一方面,它们的KV缓存以16位精度存储,由于它们不使用GQA,其大小为32 ⋅ 2560 ⋅ 2 ⋅ 2 ⋅ 8192 = 32\cdot 2560\cdot 2\cdot 8192= 2.5GB 对于8k上下文.
因此TTT-E2E在8k时发生约51.6%的每序列推断态大小.
此外,TTT-E2E只执行单一的内文梯度步骤,而我们显示,睡眠时间的延长会导致更好的性能.

blocks.en:
Why does sleep benefit from accumulated context in loss whereas TTT-E2E does not?
One reason could be that sleep can be seen as a form of black-box meta learning method ( Hochreiter et al., 2001 ; Kirsch et al., 2022 ; Duan et al., 2016 ; Wang et al., 2016 ) , where the model can execute flexible learned updates to train the KV cache without relying on a prescribed inner-loop loss function or update rule.
On the other hand, TTT-E2E relies on prescribed inner loss (next-token loss) and update rule (gradient descent), which makes it more similar to MAML ( Finn et al., 2017 ) than the black-box meta-learning approaches and may limit the flexibility of its updates when learning from few examples.
Aligned with this intuition, Eyuboglu et al. (2026) find that using next-token loss as an inner loss for TTT can improve memorization but does not benefit other tasks such as mathematical reasoning as much.
blocks.zh:
为什么睡眠从损失的累积上下文中受益,而TTT-E2E则不受益?
一个原因可能是睡眠可以被看作是一种黑盒元的学习方法(Hochreiter等人,2001年;Kirsch等人,2022年;Duan等人,2016年;Wang等人,2016年),模型可以执行灵活的学习更新来训练KV缓存,而无需依赖规定的内存丢失功能或更新规则.
另一方面,TTT-E2E依赖于规定的内损(next-token loss)和更新规则(gradient develop),这使得它与MAML(Finn等人,2017年)比黑盒元学习方法更相似,在从少数例子学习时可能会限制其更新的灵活性.
与这种直觉一致的是,Eyuboglu等人(2026年)发现,利用下位损失作为TTT的内在损失可以改善记忆,但不会像数学推理那样有利于其他任务.

Each sequence randomly samples the shift and shares it across demonstrations so the model can infer the shift from demonstrations.
blocks.zh:
* 输入:pt 输出:pt 输入:r s y e 输出:y e r 输入:f a c e u r 输出:s u r e 输入:l e y y 输出: 预期答案是 c y c l e s. 此序列中的每一个演示都通过三个字母右转.
与Brown等人(2020年)不同,我们在每个字符之间插入间隔.
每个序列随机抽样并分享到整个演示中,这样模型就可以推断出演示中的变化.

blocks.en: B.3 HELMET-ICL
blocks.zh: B.3 赫尔辛基

blocks.en:
Here, we take three tasks from the widely used ( Abdin et al., 2024 ; Kimi Team et al., 2025 ; Zeng et al., 2026 ) ICL subset of HELMET dataset ( Yen et al., 2025 ) : TREC-coarse, TREC-fine ( Li and Roth, 2002 ) , and NLU ( Liu et al., 2021 ) .
These are text classification tasks with 6, 50, 68 labels respectively for TREC-coarse, TREC-fine, and NLU.
An example demonstration of TREC-coarse:
blocks.zh:
在这里,我们从被广泛使用者那里承担三项任务(Abdin等人,2024年;Kimi)。 Team等人,2025年;Zeng等人,2026年) HELMET数据集的ICL子集(Yen等人,2025年):TREC-coarse,TREC-fine(Li and Roth,2002年),NLU(Liu等人,2021年).
这些是文本分类任务,分别为TREC-coarse,TREC-fine和NLU的6,50,68标签.
TREC-粗体的例子:

blocks.en: ⬇ What are some tips for building a fire in a fireplace ? label : 4 How many Canadians emmigrate each year ? label : 3 What do the letters CE stand for on so many products , particularly electrical , purchased now ? label : 5 Why do movie and TV stars get paid so much ? label : 2 What building are British monarchs crowned in ? label : 1 Name the creator of ‘‘ The Muppets ’’ . label : 0 How far is it from Denver to Aspen ? label : 3 Demonstrations like this are presented to the model multiple times so the model can infer the classification rule.
blocks.zh: ⬇ 在壁炉上建火有什么提示? 标签 : 每年有多少加拿大人移民? 标签 : 3个 如此多的产品,特别是电器, 标签 : 页:1 为什么电影和电视明星 得到这么多报酬? 标签 : 2个 英国君主的冠冕是什么建筑? 标签 : 页:1 命名 {布偶} 的创建者。 标签 : 0 从丹佛到阿斯彭有多远? 标签: 3 这样的演示被多次呈现给模型,这样模型就可以推断出分类规则.

blocks.en: B.4 SST-2 nonsemantic
blocks.zh: B.4 SST-2 非语义

blocks.en:
⬇ Input : seagal ran out of movies years ago , and this is just the proof . Output : foo Input : like the rugrats movies , the wild thornberrys movie does n ’ t offer much more than the series , but its emphasis on caring for animals and respecting other cultures is particularly welcome . Output : bar Input : this is cruel , misanthropic stuff with only weak claims to surrealism and black comedy . Output : Expected answer is foo . Here, the model has to infer that foo means negative, and bar means positive.
This task is introduced in Wei et al. (2023) to decouple the model’s in-context adaptation ability from learned semantic prior.
blocks.zh:
这仅仅是证据。 野生荆棘莓电影与系列电影一样, 输出: bar 输入:这是残酷的, 产出:预期答案是foo。 在这里,模型必须推断foo表示负值,bar表示正值.
在Wei等人(2023年)中引入了这一任务,将模型的内文本适应能力与之前学到的语义脱钩.
